statAccuracyScoring.pointsAwarded: equals the predicted number itself, no fixed max, no tolerance band
statAccuracyScoring.supersedes: earlier unconfirmed tolerance/closeness placeholder and old live-site FAQ copy which had this backwards

combatSports.notes: TP (Total Punches) tracked independently, never derived from HP+BP. All per-round values stack/are cumulative in the same round.

proWrestling.matchWinnerOptions: 2-way only (A/B), no draw in the frontend prototype — confirm backend draw support before assuming otherwise
proWrestling._source: Confirmed verbatim from pro-wrestling-core.js DEFAULT_WRESTLING_SCORING_RULE and scoreCompetitor(). Per-category points = predicted value IF actual >= predicted, else 0 (floor rule) — the 'weight' field is stored per category for display/tie-break purposes but is NOT multiplied into the point total in scoreCompetitor(); do not assume it inflates score without re-checking the settlement code.
proWrestling.knownGotcha: A stat predicted as 0 must only score once the match has actually ended, per live-wrestling-scoring.js fix.

shadowFights.description: Wrapper around an already-scored archived fight, identity hidden, re-released as a fresh contest.
shadowFights.predictionLength: Full scheduled length for the sport regardless of actual finish time

_sourceOfTruth: proWrestling above is confirmed against the real pro-wrestling-core.js file. combatSports above is still the design team's model and has NOT been confirmed against an equivalent real combat-sports scoring file — verify against the backend's actual MMA/boxing scoring module before relying on it. If this file and the real backend code ever conflict, the real code wins.
